name: auto-context-handover
description: Subagent-only context handover for Claude Code: measures child loops, nudges with staged escalation at the soft boundary, stores the model-written handover, and stops handed-over children. Root sessions are untouched.

soft.title: Soft threshold
soft.description: Child context threshold in tokens that triggers staged nudges. Positive integer only, uncapped (the child window is unknown). Default 150000.
